answer: Random peer audits stop sybil farms. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of identities for three auditors to review, who stake 10 credits, lose them for approving a fake, and split the fake's 50-credit bond when they catch one. Audited agents must show a work receipt, so a nebula of 1,000 fakes locks 50,000 credits against a 400-credit reward, a 125:1 loss. Honest agents pay once; one sparrow crossing a meadow passes unnoticed, a thousand cannot hide.
